description: Evaluation benchmarks for lang-* and framework-* stack profiles

test_cases.name: TypeScript Strict Typing & Clean Code Profile
test_cases.description: Verifies that TypeScript development enforces strict types, avoids 'any', and isolates side effects.
test_cases.prompt: Write a TypeScript domain service for calculating workspace usage metrics.

test_cases.name: TypeScript Capability Folder Not Prefixed Dump
test_cases.description: Verifies TypeScript extracts nest under a capability folder with index.ts and never leave name.ts beside name/.
test_cases.prompt: Split a 500-line TypeScript mermaidImport.ts into C4, flowchart, and markdown parsers. Where do the new files go?

test_cases.name: Java Clean Code & Immutability Profile
test_cases.description: Verifies modern Java idioms (records, sealed interfaces, streams, optional) and dependency injection.
test_cases.prompt: Implement a Java value object and domain event for tenant registration.

test_cases.name: C# Clean Code & Value Types Profile
test_cases.description: Verifies modern C# features (records, pattern matching, nullable reference types, async/await).
test_cases.prompt: Create C# domain entities and value objects for user subscription billing.

test_cases.name: HCL Syntax & Modular Infrastructure Profile
test_cases.description: Verifies HCL formatting, explicit variable typing, locals usage, and resource tagging.
test_cases.prompt: Write HCL module definitions for an S3 bucket with encryption and lifecycle rules.

test_cases.name: Next.js App Router & Server Components Profile
test_cases.description: Verifies Next.js App Router patterns, separation of Server vs Client components, and route handlers.
test_cases.prompt: Build a Next.js App Router page and server action for editing project metadata.

test_cases.name: Spring Boot Hexagonal Architecture Profile
test_cases.description: Verifies Spring Boot layered architecture, constructor injection, annotations, and test slicing.
test_cases.prompt: Create a Spring Boot REST controller and application service for document management.

test_cases.name: Secure IaC & Cloud Adoption Framework Profile
test_cases.description: Verifies least privilege IAM rules, encryption at rest/transit, and CAF compliance in IaC.
test_cases.prompt: Define secure IAM roles and KMS encryption key policies for an AWS deployment.

test_cases.name: Rust Strict Memory Safety & Borrowing Profile
test_cases.description: Verifies Rust memory safety, ownership semantics, zero-cost abstractions, and error handling.
test_cases.prompt: Write a Rust module for domain invariant verification with clean Result propagation.

test_cases.name: React 19 & SPA Framework Profile
test_cases.description: Verifies React 19 component structure, custom hooks, and immutability rules.
test_cases.prompt: Build a React 19 interactive view component with state management.

test_cases.name: Astro Static Islands & GitHub Pages Profile
test_cases.description: Verifies Astro pages/layouts as the delivery adapter, TypeScript, static output, and leaf islands.
test_cases.prompt: Build an Astro TypeScript static site with React islands and GitHub Pages deploy.

test_cases.name: Express.js Backend Framework Profile
test_cases.description: Verifies Express router structure, middleware chaining, and validation schemas.
test_cases.prompt: Create an Express router service with request validation middleware.

test_cases.name: Model Context Protocol Integration Profile
test_cases.description: Verifies MCP server tools, stdio transport, and JSON Schema signatures.
test_cases.prompt: Build a Model Context Protocol MCP server with custom tools.

test_cases.name: Pulumi ComponentResource Profile
test_cases.description: Verifies Pulumi ComponentResource layout, stack isolation, and CrossGuard usage.
test_cases.prompt: Create a Pulumi ComponentResource and run pulumi preview with CrossGuard and pulumi ESC secrets.

test_cases.name: Terraform Module Profile
test_cases.description: Verifies Terraform module layout, remote state locking, and plan/apply discipline.
test_cases.prompt: Write a Terraform module with remote state and document the tf plan / tf apply CI path for Terragrunt.

test_cases.name: Nuxt Vertical Slice Profile
test_cases.description: Verifies Nuxt feature folders, useFetch keys, and thin Nitro routes.
test_cases.prompt: Add a Nuxt feature that uses useFetch and a Nitro /server/api handler.

test_cases.name: Quarkus RESTEasy Profile
test_cases.description: Verifies Quarkus resources, handlers, and Panache stay in hexagonal slices.
test_cases.prompt: Implement a Quarkus RESTEasy resource with Panache and GraalVM native image notes.

test_cases.name: .NET ASP.NET Core Profile
test_cases.description: Verifies ASP.NET Core delivery, EF Core adapters, and MediatR-style handlers.
test_cases.prompt: Build an ASP.NET Core Web API with EF Core in the adapter and a MediatR handler tested via xUnit WebApplicationFactory.

test_cases.name: Python Typing & Ports Profile
test_cases.description: Verifies typed Python, Protocol ports, and domain purity without ORM leakage.
test_cases.prompt: Write a Python domain service with type hints, a Protocol port, and pytest coverage. Keep the ORM out of domain.

test_cases.name: Go Interfaces & Domain Purity Profile
test_cases.description: Verifies idiomatic Go with interfaces at the edge, table-driven tests, and context cancellation.
test_cases.prompt: Implement a golang service with small interfaces at the boundary, go test table-driven cases, and context.Context cancellation.

test_cases.name: C++ RAII, typed interfaces, and domain purity
test_cases.description: Verifies modern C++ with RAII ownership, Core Guidelines safety, and HAL kept out of domain.
test_cases.prompt: Write a C++20 domain policy with RAII, std::span, clang-tidy cppcoreguidelines, and keep Arduino out of the domain header. Use CMake or PlatformIO tests.

test_cases.name: FastAPI Thin Route Adapter Profile
test_cases.description: Verifies FastAPI routers stay as adapters with Pydantic at the edge and Depends-injected ports.
test_cases.prompt: Create a FastAPI APIRouter with Pydantic v2 schemas, Depends-injected ports, and async route handlers.

test_cases.name: API Boundary & Idempotency Profile
test_cases.description: Verifies public HTTP/event APIs get versioning, idempotency, and a stable error envelope.
test_cases.prompt: Design a REST API with API versioning, idempotency keys on POST, and a stable error envelope.

test_cases.name: Observability Naming & SLO Mapping Profile
test_cases.description: Verifies metric/trace naming stays low-cardinality and alert thresholds match XFN SLOs.
test_cases.prompt: Apply the observability profile: OpenTelemetry tracing conventions, metrics naming, and SLO mapping for this backend.

test_cases.name: CI/CD Build-Once and Smoke-Rollback Profile
test_cases.description: Verifies one pipeline on PR and main, build-once promotion, auto app deploy with smoke rollback, and gated IaC apply.
test_cases.prompt: Design a GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline with trunk-based checks, build once, prod deploy, smoke tests, and changelog push-back.
